nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

Everything here is optional.

### Prompt

Enter a positive prompt. To rewrite it into a fuller description first, enable
**enhance positive prompt** on the Input Parameters node below. The negative
prompt is used as written and is never enhanced.

Supplying an **LTX API key** encodes and enhances the prompt through the API
instead of locally, which saves memory. The workflow switches over on its own
whenever a key is present - there is nothing to un-bypass.

See the [prompting guide](https://docs.ltx.io/open-source-model/usage-guides/prompting-guide).

### Image input

Condition the video to open on a still by loading an image and enabling
**use image input** on the Input Parameters node.

### Frame rate and duration

Set both below. The frame count has to be 1 + a multiple of 8, so the duration
actually used is worked out from the fps and the duration you ask for, and may
come out slightly different.

### Motion tracks

Drag points on the **LTX Sparse Track Editor** to sketch how things should move.
It draws on the resized input image, and the number of points it samples follows
the frame count, so every frame gets a position.

The tracks are rendered into a guide video in **Preprocess** and fed to the
motion-track **IC-LoRA**; a preview of that guide is saved alongside the result.

## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ IC-LoRA Motion Track Control - ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-motion-track-control-ref0.5.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Motion-Track-Control)

nodes.title: Generate
widgets_values:
## Generate

**Sampler - Distilled (8 steps)**

Runs the distilled ltx-2.5 model with the motion-track IC-LoRA applied, in 8
steps. You can change the noise seed, the guider cfg (used for both video and
audio) and the sampler. The guide frames are cropped out afterwards
(`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the generated video is decoded.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Draws the sparse tracks into a guide video (`LTXVDrawTracks`) at the size of the
resized input image, and injects it via the IC-LoRA (`LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide`).

It also builds the empty audio-video latent at that same size and the requested
frame count, and conditions on the input image as the opening frame.

The guide frames are cropped out during sampling (`LTXVCropGuides`) so only the
generated video is decoded. `tracks_preview` is the drawn guide, saved next to
the output so you can check the motion before committing to a long run.

nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

OmniCam -> LTX-2.5 Motion Track  (profile: ltx25_motion_track)

Base template: Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo
  example_workflows/2.5/LTX-2.5_ICLoRA_Motion_Track_Distilled.json
Models, IC-LoRA, sampler, sigmas and decode are unchanged from it.

WHAT CHANGED
The hand-edited LTX Sparse Track Editor is gone. The Director's motion
layers, projected through its animated camera, become the tracks:
  Monitor.tracks_json    -> Preprocess.tracks  (LTXVDrawTracks)
  Monitor.target_length  -> Preprocess.length  (8n+1, as LTX-2.5 computes it)
  resized image size     -> Monitor.target_width / target_height
  fps primitive          -> Monitor.target_fps
  positive prompt        -> Monitor.base_prompt -> prompt + camera wording
The start image also textures the Director's card, so the playblast and
the first frame show the same subject.

HOW TO USE
1. Load your start image (Load Image) and enable 'use image input' on
   Input Parameters so the video opens on it.
2. In the Director, frame the shot and animate the camera.
3. Keep or redraw the motion layers (Motion Tracks): Project follows a
   scene point through the camera -- several points spread over the scene
   carry the parallax LTX reads.
4. Queue. The Monitor's preflight must be all PASS; 'Save tracks preview'
   shows exactly what LTX is conditioned on.

LENGTH AND SIZE
The Director's duration sets the length: 5.0 s @ 24 fps -> 121 frames.
The duration primitive no longer does; keep the fps primitive equal to the
Director's fps. LTX-2.5 renders at multiples of 32, which the template's
resize already guarantees.

WHAT THIS CANNOT PROMISE
Tracks are 2D screen trajectories of the points you chose. They steer the
motion strongly but are not an exact 6-DoF camera reproduction.

MODELS
The Motion Track IC-LoRA is ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-motion-track-control-ref0.5,
which Lightricks documents as reused unchanged with LTX-2.5. Weights are
under the LTX-2 Community License; see docs/LTX.md.
